messages.content:
Judy teaches 5 dance classes, every day, on the weekdays and 8 classes on Saturday.  If each class has 15 students and she charges $15.00 per student, how much money does she make in 1 week?

End your reply with a line of the form 'Final answer: N', where N is the final number.

Judy teaches \(5 \times 5 = 25\) classes on weekdays, plus 8 classes on Saturday:

\[
25 + 8 = 33 \text{ classes}
\]

Each class earns:

\[
15 \text{ students} \times \$15 = \$225
\]

Weekly earnings:

\[
33 \times \$225 = \$7{,}425
\]

Final answer: 7425
